title: Second Brain Claim
description: One immutable record in ClaimStore/claims/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl. Never rewritten after creation - current state is derived by replaying events (see claimstore.current_status), not by mutating this record.

trace_id.description: Groups claims extracted from the same connector run for end-to-end tracing.

connector.description: Free-form connector name (e.g. x_bookmarks, capture, gmail). Not a closed enum - new connectors don't require a schema change.

id.description: Stable source-system ID - a tweet ID, a file path, a meeting UUID. Never a title/date guess. See docs/connector-contract.md on idempotency.

ref.description: Vault wikilink if this resolves to an existing note, else null.

operation.description: What kind of change this claim represents. KEP's routing (second_brain/kep.py) is a deterministic function of this field.

target_note.description: Vault path this claim would affect, if known.

kep_state.description: Informational snapshot at write time; the authoritative current status is derived from events.

output_refs.description: Vault paths this claim ultimately produced/affected, appended by later events - not mutated in place on the claim record.
